messages:
priya: Noticing a small percentage of Azure AD SCIM provisioning runs are creating users without assigned roles after last night's KMS alias rotation. Tenant-scoped, not system-wide. Anyone else?

maria: I got a couple of alerts too. Any logs/sample payload?

priya: Snippet from provisioner logs (redacted):
```
INFO provisioner: apply start tenant=ten-0a1 user=bob@org.com
ERROR provisioner: decrypt_role_blob failed: kms:Decrypt error: jwe_context_mismatch
WARN provisioner: assigning default roles due to role decrypt failure
```

sam: jwe_context_mismatch => likely encryption context changed during the rotate. Did we start including tenant_hash in context?

maria: Yes. During the alias rotate we added tenant_hash to the encryption context for extra binding. Old blobs were not re-enveloped, so decrypt with the new context fails.

priya: Impact looks low so far: 32 users across 4 tenants. All EU tenants. No customer tickets yet but could lead to privilege gaps.

sam: Short options: (A) bulk rewrap old blobs with new context, (B) provisioner tries old context as fallback for N days, (C) roll alias back if possible.

sec-oncall: Mitigate fast: add fallback decrypt path to try previous context before falling back to default roles. Also start telemetry: scim.decrypt_failure{reason="context_mismatch"} and scim.fallback_role_assigned. If >100 users hit, open a customer incident.

maria: I'll schedule a rewrap job for affected tenants. Need write access to alias `alias/redwood-provisioner-v2`.

sam: I'll add a small code patch behind a feature flag to try previous_context on decrypt, and include tenant_hash (redacted) and key_id in logs. Will avoid logging full blob.

provision-bot: automation: queued rewrap job rp-20260401-03 for 4 tenants, 32 users.

priya: Good. Also add an internal post-rotation checklist item: rewrap any persisted role blobs and keep previous key accessible for 48h.

maria: Rewrap kicked off. Monitoring job: rp-20260401-03.

sam: PR for fallback decrypt ready for review, feature flagged. Adds metrics and a debug log when fallback used.

provision-bot: automation: rp-20260401-03 completed. 32 blobs rewrapped, 0 failures.

maria: Verified role assignments applied after rewrap and re-run of provisioner.

sec-oncall: Closing as mitigated. Action items going to postmortem: (1) add rewrap step to key-rotation runbook, (2) ensure backward-compatible context handling or staged rollout, (3) telemetry threshold for automated customer notifications.

priya: I'll draft the internal incident note and low-severity customer template in case anyone asks. Thanks everyone.

sam: Merged fallback patch behind flag and added metrics.

priya: Thread resolved, creating PMR/postmortem ticket and linking runbook changes. :white_check_mark:
